posts.text: As my second term as a Product Management Intern at SAP comes to an end, I’ve been reflecting on the experience and the people who made these past two terms so memorable. Over my two terms, I had the opportunity to work across a range of problems within SAP HANA Cloud, from product strategy and customer feedback to AI, rapid prototyping, and developer-facing content. This summer especially gave me the chance to explore the agentic AI landscape, collaborate with engineering and UX on MVPs and pro

I've always loved a good hardware build, but this weekend was the first time I got to build something like this from the ground up. At Hack the 6ix, my teammates Jasmehar Kaur, Srija Chitturi, and I built hand.shake; a wearable assistive glove designed to help people with reduced grip strength hold and carry everyday objects. The system combined embedded systems, computer vision, and AI: - A Raspberry Pi 5 running QNX captured images with an onboard camera. - A vision model identified the object

I'm thrilled to announce that I’ll be joining SAP this fall as a Product Manager Intern through the SAP iXp program! Excited to learn, build, and help shape product experiences that make a difference at the SAP HANA team. 🚀 Big thanks to Renejane Niña Villanueva, Jose Ramos, and Dan van Leeuwen for the support throughout the process! If you’re also joining SAP this term, let’s connect – I would love to meet some fellow interns! :)🌟 #SAPiXp #LifeAtSAP
